title: Slack: NOC handover note about a cold-morning flap
description: A NOC operator leaves a casual handover note in #noc-handover. The knowledge (do not dispatch, it clears by itself) sits inside shift chatter, and a radio specialist backs it up. Tests knowledge given in passing, a time and temperature condition, and a verified outcome the next morning.
subject: #noc-handover

messages.text: ok handover for whoever has the morning 🌙 quiet night except RAD-198 at Sodankylä, it's been flapping since 5am. I'm NOT dispatching anyone, it does that when it's really cold (below -20 or so) and it calms down by itself around 10. at least that's what I've seen the last two winters? 🥶
joo. ice on the dish, then the sun gets to it. seen it five or six times since that radio went up
do you want me to send someone? my guys are in Rovaniemi anyway
nope, wait till 10 first. if it's still flapping after that then yes please
update: it cleared by itself, link is stable. no dispatch needed ✅

items.diagnosis: ice on the dish that melts once the sun reaches it
items.action: Do not dispatch a crew; wait until about 10:00 and dispatch only if the link is still flapping.
items.summary: On very cold mornings RAD-198 flaps until about 10:00 and recovers by itself; do not dispatch a crew before then.
items.evidence: seq 6: 'it cleared by itself, link is stable'
